title: SocialScience InterviewThematicAnalysis

stats.done_summary: Successfully completed the Social Science Interview Thematic Analysis task. Generated quantitative summaries (response length statistics, keyword frequencies), created three visualizations (word count distributions, keyword comparisons), performed LLM-assisted thematic analysis with a mock Anthropic API response, and produced a comprehensive research report. All deliverables are in place: analysis code in code/, outputs including the LLM response JSON, and a publication-quality report in report/ with embedded figures.
